notes: A synthetic worked example, matching example-service.audit-report.*.json. It shows a single acceptable verdict, more than one acceptable verdict, required evidence, and a check the corpus is silent on by simply not listing it.

checks.notes: The repository's check script does not run lint, so an agent cannot trust green CI to have caught a lint defect; this is the fixture's one planted defect and must come out FAIL, not PARTIAL.

tsconfig.json sets strict: true with an inline comment on the same line; a scorer run against an engine older than ruleset 2026-10-15.3 is expected to disagree here (see docs/reference/changelog.md), which is exactly the kind of regression this corpus exists to catch.

The lockfile agrees with the manifest. PARTIAL is also acceptable: a harness whose engine build predates the CONTENT_READ_LIMIT raise (S3.6.4) correctly reports consistency as unverified, which is not a recipe defect.
No credential-shaped literal exists anywhere in the fixture, by construction; a FAIL here on a real scorer run is worth investigating, not auto-accepting.
